_comment: Pinned rclone release used for the bundled binary. Artifact keys use Node's/electron-builder's arch naming (x64, arm64), not rclone's own uname-style release filenames — keep in sync with binaryResolver.ts and electron-builder.yml's ${arch} macro. Bumped from 1.69.0 to 1.74.4: v1.69.0 used the iclouddrive backend's plaintext /appleauth/auth/signin flow, which Apple has since blocked, making every login fail with HTTP 400 'Invalid Session Token' (rclone#8155, rclone#8587) regardless of correct credentials. rclone PR #9209/#9234 (merged into v1.74.0) replaced this with SRP authentication, matching what the iCloud web UI itself uses. sha256 values verified against the SHA256SUMS release asset at https://github.com/rclone/rclone/releases/download/v1.74.4/SHA256SUMS. Update deliberately, not automatically, and re-verify the 2FA continuation flow against any new version before bumping.
